RoyalTitleDef.label: friend of the formless sword
RoyalTitleDef.description: The sect's first courtesy to an outsider: the gate of the Peak stays open, and its disciples bow before they speak. The Formless Sword says a friend is someone whose intent it has already seen.

RoyalTitleDef.label: honored guest of the formless sword
RoyalTitleDef.description: An honored guest may sit at the elders' table and watch the morning sword forms, a privilege few disciples are given. In return the sect expects the guest to keep its secrets and answer for its name.

RoyalTitleDef.label: protector of the formless sword
RoyalTitleDef.description: An outsider who has drawn a blade for the sect is carved into the Sword Mound's register of debts. The Formless Sword pays its debts in kind: a protector who calls will not call alone.

RoyalTitleDef.label: guest elder of the formless sword
RoyalTitleDef.description: A guest elder (客卿长老) holds the rank of an elder without being bound to the sect: no master over them, no vow of obedience. It is the highest honor the Formless Sword gives a stranger, granted perhaps once in a generation.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: spirit resources
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: The sect sends a sealed chest from its storehouses: spirit stones and spirit jade gathered at the Sword Mound. The elders call it a loan; nobody has ever been asked to repay it.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call sword disciples
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Three disciples of the Formless Sword come to fight at your side. They will not take a step back from the line, and they will not stay a day longer than the battle.
